scope_resolution: sanitized: native workspace and project identifiers removed
state_policy: resolve project backlog/unstarted state mapped to TODO
type_policy: inspect and use configured epic/task types

epics.title: Build the Company Brain runtime and graph foundation
epics.description: Provide the local runtime, shared contracts, durable graph publication and bounded reads required by all workflows. Complete when its four child tasks meet their acceptance criteria.

epics.title: Connect project evidence and verify development decisions
epics.description: Read real tracker/document/Git evidence, import explicit relationships, verify branch bases and evaluate inferred task-to-branch associations.

epics.title: Deliver cited answers and a reproducible demo
epics.description: Explain engine facts, present evidence and decisions, document the demo procedure and retain measured acceptance results.

epics.title: Investigate incidents and restore a disposable sandbox
epics.description: Resolve exact runtime scope, investigate with bounded checks, and demonstrate one approved restoration with measured recovery.

tasks.title: Bootstrap the local API and FalkorDB runtime
tasks.description: Create the Python API, pinned dependencies, local Compose configuration, environment example and startup instructions. This task establishes startup, not graph-backed question answering.
acceptance_criteria: The documented PowerShell startup works; `/health` exposes liveness and `/ready` distinguishes an unavailable/uninitialized graph.
Database storage survives restart using the tested image configuration; secrets are absent from responses and committed examples.
Record tested versions and actual startup checks.

tasks.title: Define shared query, evidence and incident contracts
tasks.description: Implement the canonical typed request/response records and validation, including source access, association audits, answer facts, graph availability, investigation checks and sandbox action states.
acceptance_criteria: Invalid IDs/enums and unscoped requests are rejected; clarification and uncertainty have typed outcomes.
`UNAVAILABLE`, `MISSING` and `NOT_CHECKED` remain distinct; inferred associations cannot masquerade as delivery.
Schema examples and focused contract validation agree with the canonical specification.

tasks.title: Publish graph snapshots with durable import recovery
tasks.description: Implement one writer, validated batch imports, the durable import fence and generation/readiness checks. Keep control records and retained content outside disposable graph projection storage.
acceptance_criteria: Interrupted mutation and restart block reads until a complete validated rebuild succeeds.
Preparation failure preserves the prior snapshot at its original age; publication increments generation consistently.
Direct and MCP-backed reads use the same gate; graph rebuild does not erase access records, association audits or action receipts.

tasks.title: Add bounded graph queries and traversal evidence
tasks.description: Implement parameterized, scoped templates for task context, dependencies, documents, progress and runtime neighbors, with evidence and coverage metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Queries obey tenant/project/repository scope and configured row/depth limits; overflow is visible.
A diamond dependency graph is not a cycle; real task cycles are reported; runtime cycles use visited tracking.
Return stable evidence IDs and graph paths; no generated unrestricted Cypher or model writes.

tasks.title: Read Plane tasks, assignees and activity history
tasks.description: Build the read-only Plane adapter for this project's actual tasks, metadata, parents, statuses, assignees and activity pages. Reconstruct usable assignment/in-progress intervals without invented start times.
acceptance_criteria: Preserve native IDs, all assignees, source timestamps and pagination coverage; unknown types/states stay explicit.
Read back at least one seeded task through the live adapter and retain sanitized evidence.
Incomplete activity history prevents unsupported temporal association; source access handling uses T08's shared registry when integrated.

tasks.title: Read versioned Google Docs content and anchors
tasks.description: Build the allowlisted read-only document adapter, preserving tabs, headings, lists and tables with immutable normalized content and versioned citations.
acceptance_criteria: A document changed during retrieval is retried once or rejected as incomplete; unsupported content is reported.
A live document with multiple tabs and a table produces verifiable sections/citations.
Source access handling uses T08's shared registry when integrated; unavailable live access never silently becomes fixture success.

tasks.title: Collect Git and GitHub implementation evidence
tasks.description: Read allowed repository refs, full commit identities, PR state, individual reviews and bounded changed-file evidence. Support actual Git verification separately from provider metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Preserve author versus committer identity/time, exact heads and PR targets; `closed` is not automatically `merged`.
Missing objects, incomplete history or failed fetches produce uncertainty, not absence.
Retain real implementation and integration SHAs only when observed; never use placeholder hashes.

tasks.title: Import verified relationships and retain source access state
tasks.description: Normalize adapter snapshots and the operator-reviewed manifest into graph batches. Implement the durable source access registry independently of successful imports and graph generations.
acceptance_criteria: Validate explicit task/repository/document/dependency mappings, endpoint scope and source-specific `LIVE`/`IMPORT`/`FIXTURE` modes.
Denied content stays suppressed after failed import/restart, including traces and audits; transient transport failure is not automatically revocation.
Later candidate projection preserves inference observation/expiry and never confirms delivery or triggers a query-owned rebuild.

tasks.title: Verify prerequisite coverage and recommend a branch base
tasks.description: Implement the deterministic branch policy over the full confirmed prerequisite closure and exact Git heads, including delivery groups, squash mappings, candidate-specific reverts and final freshness checks.
acceptance_criteria: Prefer verified stable coverage; otherwise select an eligible covering feature or request clarification.
Independent branches, unknown/partial mappings, cycles and stale evidence yield the appropriate outcome without unsupported commands.
Review warnings remain separate from delivery; real generated Git histories cover merge, squash, revert and reapplication cases.

tasks.title: Discover likely implementation branches from work activity
tasks.description: Use mapped assignee identities, observed work periods and bounded commit/content evidence to evaluate likely branches when explicit task references are absent. Integrate Clef with deterministic validation and visible abstention.
acceptance_criteria: Concurrent similar work can remain ambiguous; missing identity/history or provider availability is disclosed.
Suggestions carry exact observed heads, evidence, model metadata and expiry; they never establish code delivery.
Return request-local suggestions, retain audits outside the graph and evaluate actual model results against a held-out set as specified.

tasks.title: Generate cited answers from engine-owned facts
tasks.description: Build bounded context and typed facts, call an answer LLM, validate referenced facts and qualifications, and fall back to deterministic output when needed.
acceptance_criteria: Critical values/commands/statuses are engine-rendered; possible impact is never promoted to observed impact by prose.
Keep runbook prerequisites and warnings with steps; source-access and graph/head freshness gates run after inference.
Retain one real retrieval-to-LLM result; invalid citations, changed access or provider failure produce the specified safe fallback/error.

tasks.title: Present scoped questions, decisions and evidence in the UI
tasks.description: Create the query UI with task/repository clarification, exact service-instance selection, cited answers, evidence paths, source modes and decision validity.
acceptance_criteria: Display branch coverage/review warnings and distinguish inferred associations from verified bases.
Handle partial incident checks, unavailable sources, graph recovery and expired decisions; copying commands requires current eligibility.
Render action state and recovery state separately when T16 is integrated; show unknown outcomes without offering a blind retry.

tasks.title: Retain incident events and resolve exact service scope
tasks.description: Accept and deduplicate permitted incident events durably, retain incident timelines, and resolve an exact environment/region/service instance before investigation.
acceptance_criteria: Two same-named regional services require exact authorized identity or picker selection; the model cannot guess.
Unresolved accepted alerts remain pending; operator selections are recorded without overwriting contradictory source identity.
Preserve event/provider status separately from investigation results and action outcomes.

tasks.title: Investigate incidents with a controller-owned checklist
tasks.description: Implement bounded exploration of current/historical deployment, owner/on-call, runtime dependencies, customer observations and runbook context. Models may order reads; the controller owns required checks and STOP eligibility.
acceptance_criteria: Premature STOP causes a required read while budget remains; budget exhaustion returns an explicitly partial brief.
Timeout is `UNAVAILABLE`, authoritative absence is `MISSING`, and unattempted work is `NOT_CHECKED`.
Distinguish authors/owners/current responders and observed/possible impact; incomplete action prerequisites block execution plans.

tasks.title: Build the disposable payments sandbox and recovery probe
tasks.description: Create the local sandbox with immutable healthy/failing artifact versions, explicit instance identity, deployment/config/schema compatibility records and a measurable health probe.
acceptance_criteria: Every artifact/deployment identifier is real for this sandbox; synthetic customers, routes and alerts are labeled fixtures.
A failing version and a compatible healthy target can be observed without affecting real services.
Probe results include served artifact identity and the canonical 30-second, one-request-per-second recovery window; incomplete sampling is not recovery.

tasks.title: Execute one approved sandbox restoration durably
tasks.description: Implement only `RESTORE_SANDBOX_ARTIFACT`, with exact plan approval, durable execution claim, per-target serialization, retained receipts and outcome reconciliation.
acceptance_criteria: Validate exact target/current state, compatibility, access and expiry before the atomic claim; duplicates return existing operation state.
Crashes before/after mutation and receipt failures leave explicit outcomes; unknown outcome retains the target reservation and is reconciled without blind retry.
Report execution and measured recovery separately; matching artifact identity alone does not fabricate an execution receipt or close an incident.

tasks.title: Document the live-data demo and sandbox rehearsal procedure
tasks.description: Write the actual setup/rehearsal procedure, curate permitted source mappings and prepare the allowlisted demo Google Doc. Record the repository/Plane identity bindings and label synthetic runtime facts explicitly.
acceptance_criteria: Instructions cover prerequisites, source refresh, task/PR evidence, sandbox applicability, failure handling and reset ownership.
The Google Doc is manually created or created through a separately authorized document workflow, and its real ID/version is recorded; missing access is reported.
Keep expected answers and discovery ground truth out of the app's retrieval sources; document limitations without claiming passed checks.

tasks.title: Run acceptance checks and record the hackathon demonstration
tasks.description: Exercise the implemented workflows against real project evidence and isolated synthetic edge cases. Record actual outcomes, source modes, provider availability, timings and limitations.
acceptance_criteria: Live Plane and Google Docs smoke checks have actual receipts, or remain explicitly incomplete.
Rehearse task context, branch coverage, ID-free discovery when eligible, incident investigation and approved sandbox recovery; absent features are reported as not implemented.
Keep regression reports, demo procedure and evaluation counts reproducible; do not mark the task complete because tickets or fixtures were created.
